# 霧抉茶 Wu Jue Tea

> 台灣嘉義縣梅山鄉（阿里山山系）的家庭茶園品牌。一家三口 40 年自產自銷台灣高山茶：阿里山高山烏龍、金萱、蜜香紅茶、紅烏龍、四季春；並提供茶山體驗線上預約（茶席、焙茶、採茶、製茶、茶酒、黃頭鷺生態導覽）。網站提供繁體中文與英文（/en 前綴）版本，支援線上購茶與體驗預約。

Wu Jue Tea is a family-run tea farm in Meishan Township, Chiayi County, Taiwan (Alishan mountain range). For over 40 years we have grown, crafted and sold Taiwanese high-mountain teas — Alishan High Mountain Oolong, Jin Xuan (milk oolong), Honey Black Tea, Red Oolong and Four Seasons Spring — and we host on-farm tea experiences bookable online. English pages are under https://taiwantea.store/en

## 茶葉產品 Products

- [茶葉系列 Tea Collection](https://taiwantea.store/products): 阿里山高山烏龍、金萱、蜜香紅茶、紅烏龍、四季春，罐裝茶葉，自家茶園直送
- [製茶過程 Tea Craftsmanship](https://taiwantea.store/process): 採摘、萎凋、揉捻、焙火——40 年職人工序完整介紹

## 茶山體驗 Tea Experiences（線上預約 / bookable online）

- [體驗總覽 All Experiences](https://taiwantea.store/experiences)
- [茶席體驗 Tea Ceremony](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/tea-ceremony): 茶藝師帶領品茗四款高山茶，阿里山山景茶席
- [焙茶體驗 Tea Roasting](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/roasted-tea): 古早焙茶工藝，自己焙的茶帶回家
- [採茶體驗 Tea Picking](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/tea-picking): 茶園導覽、親手採摘嫩芽
- [製茶體驗 Tea Making](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/tea-making): 紅茶完整製程（約 3 小時），手作紅茶成品帶回
- [茶酒體驗 Tea Wine](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/tea-wine): 淺漬茶果酒調配（限 18 歲以上）
- [黃頭鷺導覽 Cattle Egret Tour](https://taiwantea.store/experiences/cattle-egret-tour): 季節限定茶園生態導覽
